name: AppliedVR RelieVRx
short_description: FDA-authorized VR-based digital therapeutic for chronic lower back pain that delivers CBT, mindfulness, and breathing exercises through immersive at-home sessions.
long_description: RelieVRx is the first FDA-authorized in-home virtual reality treatment clinically proven to deliver significant, lasting reduction of chronic lower back pain. The system consists of an all-in-one head-mounted VR display with integrated software and a Breathing Amplifier device that enables diaphragmatic breathing exercises. Patients complete a 56-session multimodal program featuring daily VR sessions averaging 6 minutes each, addressing the bio-psycho-social aspects of pain through cognitive behavioral therapy, body awareness training, pain distraction techniques, relaxation exercises, and mindfulness practices. The responsive training environments adapt to users' breathing and movement, helping them understand and control their nervous system response to pain without medication.
one_liner: FDA-authorized VR therapy for chronic lower back pain
best_for: and primary care providers seeking non-pharmacological treatment options for chronic lower back pain patients
not_for: Practices without patients experiencing chronic lower back pain or those unable to use VR headsets due to vestibular or vision issues

pricing.notes: Reimbursable through CMS durable medical equipment (DME) category. Highmark is first commercial payer partner covering 4+ million members. Contact for pricing details.

faqs.a: RelieVRx is the first FDA-authorized in-home virtual reality treatment for chronic lower back pain. It delivers a 56-session program using cognitive behavioral therapy, mindfulness, and breathing exercises through an immersive VR headset.

Patients self-administer daily VR sessions averaging 6 minutes each over 56 sessions. The system includes a VR headset and Breathing Amplifier sensor that guides diaphragmatic breathing exercises while immersive environments teach body awareness and relaxation techniques.
RelieVRx is reimbursable through Medicare as durable medical equipment (DME) with a unique HCPCS code. Highmark is the first commercial payer to offer coverage for 4+ million members.

Over 30 scientific articles have been published testing RelieVRx's usability, engagement, feasibility, and efficacy. Clinical trials showed no serious adverse events and a low-risk side effect profile.
